description: Render a website in headless Chromium and return its design system as a spec-valid DESIGN.md: colors, typography, spacing, radii and components, measured from the page. Several pages of one site merge into one design system. Refuses block pages, login walls and near-empty pages instead of guessing.

dark.description: Also extract the dark theme's tokens

urls.description: One or more pages of the same site, e.g. ["https://stripe.com"] or ["linear.app", "linear.app/pricing"]

name: extract_design_md
